  facet ui.semantic_root : Text = "478bed8936e79fcacdcbf648e3469d5c1ba2438c54e7332db8e9694e466effac"
  facet ui.before_root : Text = "f4104ddc4bc2d913a9ff5c47a6c97c415947959369f38c25d53d2efafa2ad3d4"
  facet event.authorized : Truth = true
  facet event.phase : Number = 1
  facet ui.state.initial : Number = 0
  facet ui.state.step : Number = binary_scale(4503599627370496, -52)
  facet ui.state.count : Number = 0
  facet ui.derived.count_label : Text = ""
  facet ui.rendered.CounterText.value : Text = ""
  subject handler { warrant ui.mutate on ui.state while event.authorized }
  subject painter { warrant ui.paint on ui }
  emergence paint {
    cause painter
    when event.phase == 1
    needs ui.paint on ui
    alter ui.derived.count_label <- (text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count))
    alter ui.rendered.CounterText.value <- ((text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count)))
    alter event.phase <- 2
    witness "ui:source-owned-projection"
  }
  foresee paint
  realize paint
}

records.source:
reality NativeUiEventExecution {
  reckon binary_scale(value : Number, exponent : Number) -> Number = choose(exponent == 0, value, choose(exponent > 0, binary_scale(value * 2, exponent - 1), binary_scale(value / 2, exponent + 1)))
  facet ui.semantic_root : Text = "478bed8936e79fcacdcbf648e3469d5c1ba2438c54e7332db8e9694e466effac"
  facet ui.before_root : Text = "f4104ddc4bc2d913a9ff5c47a6c97c415947959369f38c25d53d2efafa2ad3d4"
  facet event.authorized : Truth = true
  facet event.phase : Number = 0
  facet ui.state.initial : Number = 0
  facet ui.state.step : Number = binary_scale(4503599627370496, -52)
  facet ui.state.count : Number = 0
  facet ui.derived.count_label : Text = ""
  facet ui.rendered.CounterText.value : Text = ""
  subject handler { warrant ui.mutate on ui.state while event.authorized }
  subject painter { warrant ui.paint on ui }
  emergence dispatch {
    cause handler
    when event.phase == 0
    needs ui.mutate on ui.state
    alter ui.state.count <- (ui.state.count + ui.state.step)
    alter event.phase <- 1
    witness "ui:source-owned-event"
  }
  emergence paint {
    cause painter
    when event.phase == 1
    needs ui.paint on ui
    alter ui.derived.count_label <- (text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count))
    alter ui.rendered.CounterText.value <- ((text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count)))
    alter event.phase <- 2
    witness "ui:source-owned-projection"
  }
  foresee dispatch
  realize dispatch
  foresee paint
  realize paint
}

reality NativeUiEventExecution {
  reckon binary_scale(value : Number, exponent : Number) -> Number = choose(exponent == 0, value, choose(exponent > 0, binary_scale(value * 2, exponent - 1), binary_scale(value / 2, exponent + 1)))
  facet ui.semantic_root : Text = "478bed8936e79fcacdcbf648e3469d5c1ba2438c54e7332db8e9694e466effac"
  facet ui.before_root : Text = "f4104ddc4bc2d913a9ff5c47a6c97c415947959369f38c25d53d2efafa2ad3d4"
  facet event.authorized : Truth = true
  facet event.phase : Number = 1
  facet ui.state.initial : Number = 0
  facet ui.state.step : Number = binary_scale(4503599627370496, -52)
  facet ui.state.count : Number = 0
  facet ui.derived.count_label : Text = ""
  facet ui.rendered.CounterText.value : Text = ""
  subject handler { warrant ui.mutate on ui.state while event.authorized }
  subject painter { warrant ui.paint on ui }
  emergence paint {
    cause painter
    when event.phase == 1
    needs ui.paint on ui
    alter ui.derived.count_label <- (text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count))
    alter ui.rendered.CounterText.value <- ((text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count)))
    alter event.phase <- 2
    witness "ui:source-owned-projection"
  }
  foresee paint
  realize paint
}

  facet ui.semantic_root : Text = "478bed8936e79fcacdcbf648e3469d5c1ba2438c54e7332db8e9694e466effac"
  facet ui.before_root : Text = "f4104ddc4bc2d913a9ff5c47a6c97c415947959369f38c25d53d2efafa2ad3d4"
  facet event.authorized : Truth = true
  facet event.phase : Number = 1
  facet ui.state.initial : Number = 0
  facet ui.state.step : Number = binary_scale(4503599627370496, -52)
  facet ui.state.count : Number = 0
  facet ui.derived.count_label : Text = ""
  facet ui.rendered.CounterText.value : Text = ""
  subject handler { warrant ui.mutate on ui.state while event.authorized }
  subject painter { warrant ui.paint on ui }
  emergence paint {
    cause painter
    when event.phase == 1
    needs ui.paint on ui
    alter ui.derived.count_label <- (text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count))
    alter ui.rendered.CounterText.value <- ((text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count)))
    alter event.phase <- 2
    witness "ui:source-owned-projection"
  }
  foresee paint
  realize paint
}

  reckon binary_scale(value : Number, exponent : Number) -> Number = choose(exponent == 0, value, choose(exponent > 0, binary_scale(value * 2, exponent - 1), binary_scale(value / 2, exponent + 1)))
  facet ui.semantic_root : Text = "478bed8936e79fcacdcbf648e3469d5c1ba2438c54e7332db8e9694e466effac"
  facet ui.before_root : Text = "9c6567ec2855fe0a5d7c43f378fb6c95dbd782bf1dca9ee0c3ca1e5257da4aaf"
  facet event.authorized : Truth = true
  facet event.phase : Number = 0
  facet ui.state.initial : Number = 0
  facet ui.state.step : Number = binary_scale(4503599627370496, -52)
  facet ui.state.count : Number = binary_scale(4503599627370496, -51)
  facet ui.derived.count_label : Text = ""
  facet ui.rendered.CounterText.value : Text = ""
  subject handler { warrant ui.mutate on ui.state while event.authorized }
  subject painter { warrant ui.paint on ui }
  emergence dispatch {
    cause handler
    when event.phase == 0
    needs ui.mutate on ui.state
    alter ui.state.count <- ui.state.initial
    alter event.phase <- 1
    witness "ui:source-owned-event"
  }
  emergence paint {
    cause painter
    when event.phase == 1
    needs ui.paint on ui
    alter ui.derived.count_label <- (text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count))
    alter ui.rendered.CounterText.value <- ((text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count)))
    alter event.phase <- 2
    witness "ui:source-owned-projection"
  }
  foresee dispatch
  realize dispatch
  foresee paint
  realize paint
}

reality NativeUiEventExecution {
  reckon binary_scale(value : Number, exponent : Number) -> Number = choose(exponent == 0, value, choose(exponent > 0, binary_scale(value * 2, exponent - 1), binary_scale(value / 2, exponent + 1)))
  facet ui.semantic_root : Text = "478bed8936e79fcacdcbf648e3469d5c1ba2438c54e7332db8e9694e466effac"
  facet ui.before_root : Text = "f4104ddc4bc2d913a9ff5c47a6c97c415947959369f38c25d53d2efafa2ad3d4"
  facet event.authorized : Truth = true
  facet event.phase : Number = 1
  facet ui.state.initial : Number = 0
  facet ui.state.step : Number = binary_scale(4503599627370496, -52)
  facet ui.state.count : Number = 0
  facet ui.derived.count_label : Text = ""
  facet ui.rendered.CounterText.value : Text = ""
  subject handler { warrant ui.mutate on ui.state while event.authorized }
  subject painter { warrant ui.paint on ui }
  emergence paint {
    cause painter
    when event.phase == 1
    needs ui.paint on ui
    alter ui.derived.count_label <- (text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count))
    alter ui.rendered.CounterText.value <- ((text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count)))
    alter event.phase <- 2
    witness "ui:source-owned-projection"
  }
  foresee paint
  realize paint
}

  reckon binary_scale(value : Number, exponent : Number) -> Number = choose(exponent == 0, value, choose(exponent > 0, binary_scale(value * 2, exponent - 1), binary_scale(value / 2, exponent + 1)))
  facet ui.semantic_root : Text = "478bed8936e79fcacdcbf648e3469d5c1ba2438c54e7332db8e9694e466effac"
  facet ui.before_root : Text = "f4104ddc4bc2d913a9ff5c47a6c97c415947959369f38c25d53d2efafa2ad3d4"
  facet event.authorized : Truth = true
  facet event.phase : Number = 1
  facet ui.state.initial : Number = 0
  facet ui.state.step : Number = binary_scale(4503599627370496, -52)
  facet ui.state.count : Number = 0
  facet ui.derived.count_label : Text = ""
  facet ui.rendered.CounterText.value : Text = ""
  subject handler { warrant ui.mutate on ui.state while event.authorized }
  subject painter { warrant ui.paint on ui }
  emergence paint {
    cause painter
    when event.phase == 1
    needs ui.paint on ui
    alter ui.derived.count_label <- (text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count))
    alter ui.rendered.CounterText.value <- ((text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count)))
    alter event.phase <- 2
    witness "ui:source-owned-projection"
  }
  foresee paint
  realize paint
}

records.source:
reality NativeUiEventExecution {
  reckon binary_scale(value : Number, exponent : Number) -> Number = choose(exponent == 0, value, choose(exponent > 0, binary_scale(value * 2, exponent - 1), binary_scale(value / 2, exponent + 1)))
  facet ui.semantic_root : Text = "478bed8936e79fcacdcbf648e3469d5c1ba2438c54e7332db8e9694e466effac"
  facet ui.before_root : Text = "f4104ddc4bc2d913a9ff5c47a6c97c415947959369f38c25d53d2efafa2ad3d4"
  facet event.authorized : Truth = true
  facet event.phase : Number = 1
  facet ui.state.initial : Number = 0
  facet ui.state.step : Number = binary_scale(4503599627370496, -52)
  facet ui.state.count : Number = 0
  facet ui.derived.count_label : Text = ""
  facet ui.rendered.CounterText.value : Text = ""
  subject handler { warrant ui.mutate on ui.state while event.authorized }
  subject painter { warrant ui.paint on ui }
  emergence paint {
    cause painter
    when event.phase == 1
    needs ui.paint on ui
    alter ui.derived.count_label <- (text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count))
    alter ui.rendered.CounterText.value <- ((text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count)))
    alter event.phase <- 2
    witness "ui:source-owned-projection"
  }
  foresee paint
  realize paint
}

reality NativeUiEventExecution {
  reckon binary_scale(value : Number, exponent : Number) -> Number = choose(exponent == 0, value, choose(exponent > 0, binary_scale(value * 2, exponent - 1), binary_scale(value / 2, exponent + 1)))
  facet ui.semantic_root : Text = "478bed8936e79fcacdcbf648e3469d5c1ba2438c54e7332db8e9694e466effac"
  facet ui.before_root : Text = "f4104ddc4bc2d913a9ff5c47a6c97c415947959369f38c25d53d2efafa2ad3d4"
  facet event.authorized : Truth = true
  facet event.phase : Number = 1
  facet ui.state.initial : Number = 0
  facet ui.state.step : Number = binary_scale(4503599627370496, -52)
  facet ui.state.count : Number = 0
  facet ui.derived.count_label : Text = ""
  facet ui.rendered.CounterText.value : Text = ""
  subject handler { warrant ui.mutate on ui.state while event.authorized }
  subject painter { warrant ui.paint on ui }
  emergence paint {
    cause painter
    when event.phase == 1
    needs ui.paint on ui
    alter ui.derived.count_label <- (text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count))
    alter ui.rendered.CounterText.value <- ((text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count)))
    alter event.phase <- 2
    witness "ui:source-owned-projection"
  }
  foresee paint
  realize paint
}

  reckon binary_scale(value : Number, exponent : Number) -> Number = choose(exponent == 0, value, choose(exponent > 0, binary_scale(value * 2, exponent - 1), binary_scale(value / 2, exponent + 1)))
  facet ui.semantic_root : Text = "478bed8936e79fcacdcbf648e3469d5c1ba2438c54e7332db8e9694e466effac"
  facet ui.before_root : Text = "f4104ddc4bc2d913a9ff5c47a6c97c415947959369f38c25d53d2efafa2ad3d4"
  facet event.authorized : Truth = true
  facet event.phase : Number = 1
  facet ui.state.initial : Number = 0
  facet ui.state.step : Number = binary_scale(4503599627370496, -52)
  facet ui.state.count : Number = 0
  facet ui.derived.count_label : Text = ""
  facet ui.rendered.CounterText.value : Text = ""
  subject handler { warrant ui.mutate on ui.state while event.authorized }
  subject painter { warrant ui.paint on ui }
  emergence paint {
    cause painter
    when event.phase == 1
    needs ui.paint on ui
    alter ui.derived.count_label <- (text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count))
    alter ui.rendered.CounterText.value <- ((text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count)))
    alter event.phase <- 2
    witness "ui:source-owned-projection"
  }
  foresee paint
  realize paint
}

  reckon binary_scale(value : Number, exponent : Number) -> Number = choose(exponent == 0, value, choose(exponent > 0, binary_scale(value * 2, exponent - 1), binary_scale(value / 2, exponent + 1)))
  facet ui.semantic_root : Text = "478bed8936e79fcacdcbf648e3469d5c1ba2438c54e7332db8e9694e466effac"
  facet ui.before_root : Text = "f4104ddc4bc2d913a9ff5c47a6c97c415947959369f38c25d53d2efafa2ad3d4"
  facet event.authorized : Truth = true
  facet event.phase : Number = 0
  facet ui.state.initial : Number = 0
  facet ui.state.step : Number = binary_scale(4503599627370496, -52)
  facet ui.state.count : Number = 0
  facet ui.derived.count_label : Text = ""
  facet ui.rendered.CounterText.value : Text = ""
  subject handler { warrant ui.mutate on ui.state while event.authorized }
  subject painter { warrant ui.paint on ui }
  emergence dispatch {
    cause handler
    when event.phase == 0
    needs ui.mutate on ui.state
    alter ui.state.count <- (ui.state.count + ui.state.step)
    alter event.phase <- 1
    witness "ui:source-owned-event"
  }
  emergence paint {
    cause painter
    when event.phase == 1
    needs ui.paint on ui
    alter ui.derived.count_label <- (text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count))
    alter ui.rendered.CounterText.value <- ((text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count)))
    alter event.phase <- 2
    witness "ui:source-owned-projection"
  }
  foresee dispatch
  realize dispatch
  foresee paint
  realize paint
}

records.source:
reality NativeUiEventExecution {
  reckon binary_scale(value : Number, exponent : Number) -> Number = choose(exponent == 0, value, choose(exponent > 0, binary_scale(value * 2, exponent - 1), binary_scale(value / 2, exponent + 1)))
  facet ui.semantic_root : Text = "478bed8936e79fcacdcbf648e3469d5c1ba2438c54e7332db8e9694e466effac"
  facet ui.before_root : Text = "f4104ddc4bc2d913a9ff5c47a6c97c415947959369f38c25d53d2efafa2ad3d4"
  facet event.authorized : Truth = true
  facet event.phase : Number = 1
  facet ui.state.initial : Number = 0
  facet ui.state.step : Number = binary_scale(4503599627370496, -52)
  facet ui.state.count : Number = 0
  facet ui.derived.count_label : Text = ""
  facet ui.rendered.CounterText.value : Text = ""
  subject handler { warrant ui.mutate on ui.state while event.authorized }
  subject painter { warrant ui.paint on ui }
  emergence paint {
    cause painter
    when event.phase == 1
    needs ui.paint on ui
    alter ui.derived.count_label <- (text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count))
    alter ui.rendered.CounterText.value <- ((text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count)))
    alter event.phase <- 2
    witness "ui:source-owned-projection"
  }
  foresee paint
  realize paint

reality NativeUiEventExecution {
  reckon binary_scale(value : Number, exponent : Number) -> Number = choose(exponent == 0, value, choose(exponent > 0, binary_scale(value * 2, exponent - 1), binary_scale(value / 2, exponent + 1)))
  facet ui.semantic_root : Text = "478bed8936e79fcacdcbf648e3469d5c1ba2438c54e7332db8e9694e466effac"
  facet ui.before_root : Text = "f4104ddc4bc2d913a9ff5c47a6c97c415947959369f38c25d53d2efafa2ad3d4"
  facet event.authorized : Truth = true
  facet event.phase : Number = 1
  facet ui.state.initial : Number = 0
  facet ui.state.step : Number = binary_scale(4503599627370496, -52)
  facet ui.state.count : Number = 0
  facet ui.derived.count_label : Text = ""
  facet ui.rendered.CounterText.value : Text = ""
  subject handler { warrant ui.mutate on ui.state while event.authorized }
  subject painter { warrant ui.paint on ui }
  emergence paint {
    cause painter
    when event.phase == 1
    needs ui.paint on ui
    alter ui.derived.count_label <- (text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count))
    alter ui.rendered.CounterText.value <- ((text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count)))
    alter event.phase <- 2
    witness "ui:source-owned-projection"
  }
  foresee paint
  realize paint
}

  facet event.authorized : Truth = true
  facet event.phase : Number = 1

  facet ui.rendered.CounterText.value : Text = ""
  subject handler { warrant ui.mutate on ui.state while event.authorized }
  subject painter { warrant ui.paint on ui }
  emergence paint {

    alter event.phase <- 2
    witness "ui:source-owned-projection"
  }
  foresee paint
  realize paint
}

reality NativeUiEventExecution {
  reckon binary_scale(value : Number, exponent : Number) -> Number = choose(exponent == 0, value, choose(exponent > 0, binary_scale(value * 2, exponent - 1), binary_scale(value / 2, exponent + 1)))
  facet ui.semantic_root : Text = "478bed8936e79fcacdcbf648e3469d5c1ba2438c54e7332db8e9694e466effac"
  facet ui.before_root : Text = "f4104ddc4bc2d913a9ff5c47a6c97c415947959369f38c25d53d2efafa2ad3d4"
  facet event.authorized : Truth = true
  facet event.phase : Number = 1
  facet ui.state.initial : Number = 0
  facet ui.state.step : Number = binary_scale(4503599627370496, -52)
  facet ui.state.count : Number = 0
  facet ui.derived.count_label : Text = ""
  facet ui.rendered.CounterText.value : Text = ""
  subject handler { warrant ui.mutate on ui.state while event.authorized }
  subject painter { warrant ui.paint on ui }
  emergence paint {
    cause painter
    when event.phase == 1
    needs ui.paint on ui
    alter ui.derived.count_label <- (text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count))
    alter ui.rendered.CounterText.value <- ((text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count)))
    alter event.phase <- 2
    witness "ui:source-owned-projection"
  }
  foresee paint
  realize paint
}

  facet ui.semantic_root : Text = "478bed8936e79fcacdcbf648e3469d5c1ba2438c54e7332db8e9694e466effac"
  facet ui.before_root : Text = "f4104ddc4bc2d913a9ff5c47a6c97c415947959369f38c25d53d2efafa2ad3d4"
  facet event.authorized : Truth = true
  facet event.phase : Number = 1
  facet ui.state.initial : Number = 0
  facet ui.state.step : Number = binary_scale(4503599627370496, -52)
  facet ui.state.count : Number = 0
  facet ui.derived.count_label : Text = ""
  facet ui.rendered.CounterText.value : Text = ""
  subject handler { warrant ui.mutate on ui.state while event.authorized }
  subject painter { warrant ui.paint on ui }
  emergence paint {
    cause painter
    when event.phase == 1
    needs ui.paint on ui
    alter ui.derived.count_label <- (text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count))
    alter ui.rendered.CounterText.value <- ((text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count)))
    alter event.phase <- 2
    witness "ui:source-owned-projection"
  }
  foresee paint
  realize paint
}

reality NativeUiEventExecution {
  reckon binary_scale(value : Number, exponent : Number) -> Number = choose(exponent == 0, value, choose(exponent > 0, binary_scale(value * 2, exponent - 1), binary_scale(value / 2, exponent + 1)))
  facet ui.semantic_root : Text = "478bed8936e79fcacdcbf648e3469d5c1ba2438c54e7332db8e9694e466effac"
  facet ui.before_root : Text = "f4104ddc4bc2d913a9ff5c47a6c97c415947959369f38c25d53d2efafa2ad3d4"
  facet event.authorized : Truth = true
  facet event.phase : Number = 1
  facet ui.state.initial : Number = 0
  facet ui.state.step : Number = binary_scale(4503599627370496, -52)
  facet ui.state.count : Number = 0
  facet ui.derived.count_label : Text = ""
  facet ui.rendered.CounterText.value : Text = ""
  subject handler { warrant ui.mutate on ui.state while event.authorized }
  subject painter { warrant ui.paint on ui }
  emergence paint {
    cause painter
    when event.phase == 1
    needs ui.paint on ui
    alter ui.derived.count_label <- (text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count))
    alter ui.rendered.CounterText.value <- ((text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count)))
    alter event.phase <- 2
    witness "ui:source-owned-projection"
  }
  foresee paint
  realize paint
}

  reckon binary_scale(value : Number, exponent : Number) -> Number = choose(exponent == 0, value, choose(exponent > 0, binary_scale(value * 2, exponent - 1), binary_scale(value / 2, exponent + 1)))
  facet ui.semantic_root : Text = "48d6b3bf6bbf49b1fa87302a2120b9a83c38f570125269238c8914c6dd23a3c6"
  facet ui.before_root : Text = "6efb32e4e591515a4d1cbb3ecd9fec71904b59fdfcdbe68e27d442d4c097910b"
  facet event.authorized : Truth = true
  facet event.phase : Number = 0
  facet ui.state.initial : Number = binary_scale(5629499534213120, -50)
  facet ui.state.step : Number = binary_scale(4503599627370496, -51)
  facet ui.state.count : Number = binary_scale(5629499534213120, -50)
  facet ui.derived.count_label : Text = ""
  facet ui.rendered.CounterText.value : Text = ""
  subject handler { warrant ui.mutate on ui.state while event.authorized }
  subject painter { warrant ui.paint on ui }
  emergence dispatch {
    cause handler
    when event.phase == 0
    needs ui.mutate on ui.state
    alter ui.state.count <- (ui.state.count + ui.state.step)
    alter event.phase <- 1
    witness "ui:source-owned-event"

  emergence paint {
    cause painter

    needs ui.paint on ui
    alter ui.derived.count_label <- (text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count))
    alter ui.rendered.CounterText.value <- ((text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count)))
    alter event.phase <- 2
    witness "ui:source-owned-projection"
  }
  foresee dispatch
  realize dispatch
  foresee paint
  realize paint

  reckon binary_scale(value : Number, exponent : Number) -> Number = choose(exponent == 0, value, choose(exponent > 0, binary_scale(value * 2, exponent - 1), binary_scale(value / 2, exponent + 1)))
  facet ui.semantic_root : Text = "2e2fcb73d11c114aec7bd49ac09099d7a1190ae3156912ef6c3dac49d7d08b1e"
  facet ui.before_root : Text = "e1146878d64aed48027641e9f6e621a72315a33c86d6bd6e076de348b552ee70"
  facet event.authorized : Truth = true
  facet event.phase : Number = 1
  facet ui.state.initial : Number = 0
  facet ui.state.step : Number = binary_scale(-4503599627370496, -52)
  facet ui.state.count : Number = 0
  facet ui.derived.count_label : Text = ""
  facet ui.rendered.CounterText.value : Text = ""
  subject handler { warrant ui.mutate on ui.state while event.authorized }
  subject painter { warrant ui.paint on ui }
  emergence paint {
    cause painter
    when event.phase == 1
    needs ui.paint on ui
    alter ui.derived.count_label <- (text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count))
    alter ui.rendered.CounterText.value <- ((text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count)))
    alter event.phase <- 2
    witness "ui:source-owned-projection"
  }
  foresee paint
  realize paint
}

  reckon binary_scale(value : Number, exponent : Number) -> Number = choose(exponent == 0, value, choose(exponent > 0, binary_scale(value * 2, exponent - 1), binary_scale(value / 2, exponent + 1)))
  facet ui.semantic_root : Text = "2e2fcb73d11c114aec7bd49ac09099d7a1190ae3156912ef6c3dac49d7d08b1e"
  facet ui.before_root : Text = "e1146878d64aed48027641e9f6e621a72315a33c86d6bd6e076de348b552ee70"
  facet event.authorized : Truth = true
  facet event.phase : Number = 0
  facet ui.state.initial : Number = 0
  facet ui.state.step : Number = binary_scale(-4503599627370496, -52)
  facet ui.state.count : Number = 0
  facet ui.derived.count_label : Text = ""
  facet ui.rendered.CounterText.value : Text = ""
  subject handler { warrant ui.mutate on ui.state while event.authorized }
  subject painter { warrant ui.paint on ui }
  emergence dispatch {
    cause handler
    when event.phase == 0
    needs ui.mutate on ui.state
    alter ui.state.count <- (ui.state.count + ui.state.step)
    alter event.phase <- 1
    witness "ui:source-owned-event"
  }
  emergence paint {
    cause painter
    when event.phase == 1
    needs ui.paint on ui
    alter ui.derived.count_label <- (text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count))
    alter ui.rendered.CounterText.value <- ((text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count)))
    alter event.phase <- 2
    witness "ui:source-owned-projection"
  }
  foresee dispatch
  realize dispatch
  foresee paint
  realize paint
}

reality NativeUiEventExecution {
  reckon binary_scale(value : Number, exponent : Number) -> Number = choose(exponent == 0, value, choose(exponent > 0, binary_scale(value * 2, exponent - 1), binary_scale(value / 2, exponent + 1)))
  facet ui.semantic_root : Text = "ec9c4e932b4b75e5835c103a8829ef90e8c64968407b8fe589994b234c447ad4"
  facet ui.before_root : Text = "b0960b6873fcc61e386137b4ec8f31ed47e53867e5ca0603f06a2b75fcfa9e51"
  facet event.authorized : Truth = true
  facet event.phase : Number = 1
  facet ui.state.initial : Number = binary_scale(-7881299347898368, -50)
  facet ui.state.step : Number = binary_scale(-6755399441055744, -51)
  facet ui.state.count : Number = binary_scale(-7881299347898368, -50)
  facet ui.derived.count_label : Text = ""
  facet ui.rendered.CounterText.value : Text = ""
  subject handler { warrant ui.mutate on ui.state while event.authorized }
  subject painter { warrant ui.paint on ui }
  emergence paint {
    cause painter
    when event.phase == 1
    needs ui.paint on ui
    alter ui.derived.count_label <- (text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count))
    alter ui.rendered.CounterText.value <- ((text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count)))
    alter event.phase <- 2
    witness "ui:source-owned-projection"
  }
  foresee paint
  realize paint
}

reality NativeUiEventExecution {
  reckon binary_scale(value : Number, exponent : Number) -> Number = choose(exponent == 0, value, choose(exponent > 0, binary_scale(value * 2, exponent - 1), binary_scale(value / 2, exponent + 1)))
  facet ui.semantic_root : Text = "7ffecc0b17645cb6829a74c9281161fb4490108f20854a7129a911caa9666135"
  facet ui.before_root : Text = "ea950994e596aa71ff5fce2634eb871885c011e40cc27c82cd6d47106045547c"
  facet event.authorized : Truth = true
  facet event.phase : Number = 0
  facet ui.state.initial : Number = binary_scale(6473924464345088, -48)
  facet ui.state.step : Number = binary_scale(4503599627370496, -50)
  facet ui.state.count : Number = binary_scale(8725724278030336, -48)
  facet ui.derived.count_label : Text = ""
  facet ui.rendered.CounterText.value : Text = ""
  subject handler { warrant ui.mutate on ui.state while event.authorized }
  subject painter { warrant ui.paint on ui }
  emergence dispatch {
    cause handler
    when event.phase == 0
    needs ui.mutate on ui.state
    alter ui.state.count <- ui.state.initial
    alter event.phase <- 1
    witness "ui:source-owned-event"
  }
  emergence paint {
    cause painter
    when event.phase == 1
    needs ui.paint on ui
    alter ui.derived.count_label <- (text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count))
    alter ui.rendered.CounterText.value <- ((text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count)))
    alter event.phase <- 2
    witness "ui:source-owned-projection"
  }
  foresee dispatch
  realize dispatch
  foresee paint
  realize paint
}

  reckon binary_scale(value : Number, exponent : Number) -> Number = choose(exponent == 0, value, choose(exponent > 0, binary_scale(value * 2, exponent - 1), binary_scale(value / 2, exponent + 1)))
  facet ui.semantic_root : Text = "6f8b58d5e552e6b684b42aa5e1f2be258f404c375e30f74df888ba8c7b7d784f"
  facet ui.before_root : Text = "e2932870b5ff91371c8458dab2bf8b9ceddcc99a42069e596cd7436aad1b50a3"
  facet event.authorized : Truth = true
  facet event.phase : Number = 1
  facet ui.state.initial : Number = binary_scale(8796093022208000, -43)
  facet ui.state.step : Number = binary_scale(-4503599627370496, -49)
  facet ui.state.count : Number = binary_scale(8796093022208000, -43)
  facet ui.derived.count_label : Text = ""
  facet ui.rendered.CounterText.value : Text = ""
  subject handler { warrant ui.mutate on ui.state while event.authorized }
  subject painter { warrant ui.paint on ui }
  emergence paint {
    cause painter
    when event.phase == 1
    needs ui.paint on ui
    alter ui.derived.count_label <- (text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count))
    alter ui.rendered.CounterText.value <- ((text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count)))
    alter event.phase <- 2
    witness "ui:source-owned-projection"
  }
  foresee paint
  realize paint
}

reality NativeUiEventExecution {
  reckon binary_scale(value : Number, exponent : Number) -> Number = choose(exponent == 0, value, choose(exponent > 0, binary_scale(value * 2, exponent - 1), binary_scale(value / 2, exponent + 1)))
  facet ui.semantic_root : Text = "6e4613ff6dd42510a933f069a1de2edc1c5a5f2a2d2fc555fefdfc0cd69530c8"
  facet ui.before_root : Text = "c0c39b6d44f319b47f1a6ec8036a38858b43bc690e6f25d863a3cc60c5e89721"
  facet event.authorized : Truth = true
  facet event.phase : Number = 1
  facet ui.state.initial : Number = 0
  facet ui.state.step : Number = binary_scale(4503599627370496, -48)
  facet ui.state.count : Number = 0
  facet ui.derived.count_label : Text = ""
  facet ui.rendered.CounterText.value : Text = ""
  subject handler { warrant ui.mutate on ui.state while event.authorized }
  subject painter { warrant ui.paint on ui }
  emergence paint {
    cause painter
    when event.phase == 1
    needs ui.paint on ui
    alter ui.derived.count_label <- (text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count))
    alter ui.rendered.CounterText.value <- ((text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count)))
    alter event.phase <- 2
    witness "ui:source-owned-projection"
  }
  foresee paint
  realize paint
}

  reckon binary_scale(value : Number, exponent : Number) -> Number = choose(exponent == 0, value, choose(exponent > 0, binary_scale(value * 2, exponent - 1), binary_scale(value / 2, exponent + 1)))
  facet ui.semantic_root : Text = "5ded5b8385aa6cc6553494e26d78a7c910002cb3f78967bf02a2d3e57f76c0ff"
  facet ui.before_root : Text = "f4104ddc4bc2d913a9ff5c47a6c97c415947959369f38c25d53d2efafa2ad3d4"
  facet event.authorized : Truth = true
  facet event.phase : Number = 1
  facet ui.state.initial : Number = 0
  facet ui.state.step : Number = binary_scale(4503599627370496, -52)
  facet ui.state.count : Number = 0
  facet ui.derived.count_label : Text = ""
  facet ui.rendered.CounterText.value : Text = ""
  subject handler { warrant ui.mutate on ui.state while event.authorized }
  subject painter { warrant ui.paint on ui }
  emergence paint {
    cause painter
    when event.phase == 1
    needs ui.paint on ui
    alter ui.derived.count_label <- (text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count))
    alter ui.rendered.CounterText.value <- ((text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count)))
    alter event.phase <- 2
    witness "ui:source-owned-projection"
  }
  foresee paint
  realize paint
}

  reckon binary_scale(value : Number, exponent : Number) -> Number = choose(exponent == 0, value, choose(exponent > 0, binary_scale(value * 2, exponent - 1), binary_scale(value / 2, exponent + 1)))
  facet ui.semantic_root : Text = "478bed8936e79fcacdcbf648e3469d5c1ba2438c54e7332db8e9694e466effac"
  facet ui.before_root : Text = "f4104ddc4bc2d913a9ff5c47a6c97c415947959369f38c25d53d2efafa2ad3d4"
  facet event.authorized : Truth = true
  facet event.phase : Number = 1
  facet ui.state.initial : Number = 0
  facet ui.state.step : Number = binary_scale(4503599627370496, -52)
  facet ui.state.count : Number = 0
  facet ui.derived.count_label : Text = ""
  facet ui.rendered.CounterText.value : Text = ""
  subject handler { warrant ui.mutate on ui.state while event.authorized }
  subject painter { warrant ui.paint on ui }
  emergence paint {
    cause painter
    when event.phase == 1
    needs ui.paint on ui
    alter ui.derived.count_label <- (text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count))
    alter ui.rendered.CounterText.value <- ((text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count)))
    alter event.phase <- 2
    witness "ui:source-owned-projection"
  }
  foresee paint
  realize paint
}

records.source:
reality NativeUiEventExecution {
  reckon binary_scale(value : Number, exponent : Number) -> Number = choose(exponent == 0, value, choose(exponent > 0, binary_scale(value * 2, exponent - 1), binary_scale(value / 2, exponent + 1)))
  facet ui.semantic_root : Text = "478bed8936e79fcacdcbf648e3469d5c1ba2438c54e7332db8e9694e466effac"
  facet ui.before_root : Text = "f4104ddc4bc2d913a9ff5c47a6c97c415947959369f38c25d53d2efafa2ad3d4"
  facet event.authorized : Truth = true
  facet event.phase : Number = 0
  facet ui.state.initial : Number = 0
  facet ui.state.step : Number = binary_scale(4503599627370496, -52)
  facet ui.state.count : Number = 0
  facet ui.derived.count_label : Text = ""
  facet ui.rendered.CounterText.value : Text = ""
  subject handler { warrant ui.mutate on ui.state while event.authorized }
  subject painter { warrant ui.paint on ui }
  emergence dispatch {
    cause handler
    when event.phase == 0
    needs ui.mutate on ui.state
    alter ui.state.count <- (ui.state.count + ui.state.step)
    alter event.phase <- 1
    witness "ui:source-owned-event"
  }
  emergence paint {
    cause painter
    when event.phase == 1
    needs ui.paint on ui
    alter ui.derived.count_label <- (text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count))
    alter ui.rendered.CounterText.value <- ((text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count)))
    alter event.phase <- 2
    witness "ui:source-owned-projection"
  }
  foresee dispatch
  realize dispatch
  foresee paint
  realize paint
}

reality NativeUiEventExecution {
  reckon binary_scale(value : Number, exponent : Number) -> Number = choose(exponent == 0, value, choose(exponent > 0, binary_scale(value * 2, exponent - 1), binary_scale(value / 2, exponent + 1)))
  facet ui.semantic_root : Text = "478bed8936e79fcacdcbf648e3469d5c1ba2438c54e7332db8e9694e466effac"
  facet ui.before_root : Text = "f4104ddc4bc2d913a9ff5c47a6c97c415947959369f38c25d53d2efafa2ad3d4"
  facet event.authorized : Truth = true
  facet event.phase : Number = 1
  facet ui.state.initial : Number = 0
  facet ui.state.step : Number = binary_scale(4503599627370496, -52)
  facet ui.state.count : Number = 0
  facet ui.derived.count_label : Text = ""
  facet ui.rendered.CounterText.value : Text = ""
  subject handler { warrant ui.mutate on ui.state while event.authorized }
  subject painter { warrant ui.paint on ui }
  emergence paint {
    cause painter
    when event.phase == 1
    needs ui.paint on ui
    alter ui.derived.count_label <- (text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count))
    alter ui.rendered.CounterText.value <- ((text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count)))
    alter event.phase <- 2
    witness "ui:source-owned-projection"
  }
  foresee paint
  realize paint
}

  facet ui.semantic_root : Text = "dd7c5359913387e29b3aeb5ae7cf07b519a71ffbf59a3fe45d9d471d10a0cf35"
  facet ui.before_root : Text = "f4104ddc4bc2d913a9ff5c47a6c97c415947959369f38c25d53d2efafa2ad3d4"
  facet event.authorized : Truth = true
  facet event.phase : Number = 1
  facet ui.state.initial : Number = 0
  facet ui.state.step : Number = binary_scale(4503599627370496, -52)
  facet ui.state.count : Number = 0
  facet ui.derived.count_label : Text = ""
  facet ui.rendered.CounterText.value : Text = ""
  subject handler { warrant ui.mutate on ui.state while event.authorized }
  subject painter { warrant ui.paint on ui }
  emergence paint {
    cause painter
    when event.phase == 1
    needs ui.paint on ui
    alter ui.derived.count_label <- (text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count))
    alter ui.rendered.CounterText.value <- ((text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count)))
    alter event.phase <- 2
    witness "ui:source-owned-projection"
  }
  foresee paint
  realize paint
}

  reckon binary_scale(value : Number, exponent : Number) -> Number = choose(exponent == 0, value, choose(exponent > 0, binary_scale(value * 2, exponent - 1), binary_scale(value / 2, exponent + 1)))
  facet ui.semantic_root : Text = "dd7c5359913387e29b3aeb5ae7cf07b519a71ffbf59a3fe45d9d471d10a0cf35"
  facet ui.before_root : Text = "9c6567ec2855fe0a5d7c43f378fb6c95dbd782bf1dca9ee0c3ca1e5257da4aaf"
  facet event.authorized : Truth = true
  facet event.phase : Number = 0
  facet ui.state.initial : Number = 0
  facet ui.state.step : Number = binary_scale(4503599627370496, -52)
  facet ui.state.count : Number = binary_scale(4503599627370496, -51)
  facet ui.derived.count_label : Text = ""
  facet ui.rendered.CounterText.value : Text = ""
  subject handler { warrant ui.mutate on ui.state while event.authorized }
  subject painter { warrant ui.paint on ui }
  emergence dispatch {
    cause handler
    when event.phase == 0
    needs ui.mutate on ui.state
    alter ui.state.count <- ui.state.step
    alter event.phase <- 1
    witness "ui:source-owned-event"
  }
  emergence paint {
    cause painter
    when event.phase == 1
    needs ui.paint on ui
    alter ui.derived.count_label <- (text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count))
    alter ui.rendered.CounterText.value <- ((text("计数：") + text(ui.state.count)))
    alter event.phase <- 2
    witness "ui:source-owned-projection"
  }
  foresee dispatch
  realize dispatch
  foresee paint
  realize paint
}
